rows.quote: The hero is leashed while attached to the anchor.
rows.reason_zh: 敌方英雄连着铁锚时仍受束缚。

rows.quote: dragging the anchor behind them
rows.reason_zh: 目标超出铁链长度后仍能拖着锚移动，因此原先拒绝缠绕的判断成立。

rows.quote: Attempting to move more than %chain_length% units away from the anchor forces the hero to %max_movement_speed% move speed
rows.reason_zh: 目标试图超出铁链长度时仍会被限制移速，本次只改了锚的生命说明。

rows.quote: Tidehunter attaches a heavy anchor to an enemy hero.
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍以一名敌方英雄为目标。

rows.quote: Gush becomes a ground targeted wave ability that affects enemy units in a line.
rows.reason_zh: A杖巨浪仍能在一次施放中伤害直线上的多个敌人。

rows.quote: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit
rows.reason_zh: 基础巨浪只伤害一个敌方单位，直线范围效果仍需A杖。

rows.quote: reducing their movement speed and armor
rows.reason_zh: 持续时间从4.5秒缩短至4秒，减甲效果仍在。

rows.quote: reducing their movement speed and armor
rows.reason_zh: 持续时间缩短后，巨浪仍会降低目标的移动速度。

rows.quote: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit
rows.reason_zh: 说明中的召出对象是一股水流，没有生成带生命值的单位。

rows.quote: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit
rows.reason_zh: 基础施放仍选取一个敌方单位作为目标。

rows.quote: fish_health_bonus.base: 3→5
rows.reason_zh: 唯一变动是每条鱼增加的生命值，决定可破坏性的IsBreakable字段没有变化，原拒绝判断仍成立。

rows.quote: Bonus Damage Block only applies if another source of Damage Block will be affecting the incoming physical attack.
rows.reason_zh: 受到的物理攻击触发其他来源的伤害格挡时，渔获仍提供额外格挡。

rows.quote: damaging and stunning all nearby enemy units
rows.reason_zh: 各级伤害仍大于零，附近所有敌方单位仍会受到伤害。

rows.quote: Ravage will hit invisible units.
rows.reason_zh: 毁灭可以命中已经隐身的单位，技能本身没有赋予隐身的效果。

rows.quote: stunning all nearby enemy units
rows.reason_zh: 本次调低了部分等级的伤害，范围眩晕仍在。

rows.quote: Enemies hit by the impact take damage and are pushed away from the landing point.
rows.reason_zh: 炮塔落地时仍能对冲击范围内的多个敌人造成伤害。

rows.quote: Enemies hit by the impact take damage and are pushed away from the landing point.
rows.reason_zh: 落地冲击仍会把命中的敌人推离落点。

rows.quote: Deploys 3 uncontrollable turrets at the target location.
rows.reason_zh: 说明只确认炮塔不可控，没有给出其生命值或受击计数方式，无法据此核实召唤物的拒绝判断。

rows.quote: Blinded targets miss all physical attacks.
rows.reason_zh: 被激光致盲的目标仍会打空所有物理攻击。

rows.quote: scepter_reduction_pct.scepter: 13→9
rows.reason_zh: A杖缩小射线仍按比例直接削减目标的当前和最大生命值，削减比例降至9%。

rows.quote: Fires an intense energy beam, damaging and blinding the target.
rows.reason_zh: 基础激光仍指向一个目标并对其造成伤害和致盲。

rows.quote: Enlists an army of robotic minions to destroy enemy units in an area around Tinker.
rows.reason_zh: 一次机械行军仍能伤害修补匠周围区域内的多个敌人。

rows.quote: heal_per_second.scepter: 35→45
rows.reason_zh: A杖机械行军经过友方英雄时仍施加不可叠加的持续治疗，每秒治疗量提高至45。

rows.quote: Throws a flare towards an enemy, dealing damage, teleporting them away, slowing them
rows.reason_zh: 耀光的伤害和新增减速均作用于同一个敌人，仍无范围伤害。

rows.quote: The target is teleported further the closer they are to Tinker.
rows.reason_zh: 传送敌方目标的效果仍在，目标越靠近修补匠，被传送的距离越远。

rows.quote: teleporting them away, slowing them and reducing their Cast and Attack Range
rows.reason_zh: 7.42将原文中的缠绕替换为减速，原先接受缠绕的判断已失效。

rows.quote: The target is teleported further the closer they are to Tinker.
rows.reason_zh: 被传送的是敌方目标，修补匠自身没有位移。

rows.quote: Throws a flare towards an enemy
rows.reason_zh: 耀光仍向一个选定的敌人施放。

new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 7.42新增100%移动减速，取代原先的缠绕，减益持续3秒。

rows.quote: Bombards an area with rocks, continously doing small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units.
rows.reason_zh: 落石仍会对轰击区域内的多个敌方单位分段造成伤害。

rows.quote: Bombards an area with rocks, continously doing small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units.
rows.reason_zh: 同一片落石区域仍会持续分段生效，本次只提高了弹道速度。

rows.quote: small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units
rows.reason_zh: 落石仍会分段眩晕敌方单位。

rows.quote: a splashing attack for a limited number of attacks
rows.reason_zh: 抓树后一次攻击仍能通过溅射伤害多个敌人。

rows.quote: a splashing attack for a limited number of attacks
rows.reason_zh: 持树期间有限次数的普通攻击仍带有溅射。

rows.quote: Grabs a tree and causes Tiny to have bonus range, damage, and a splashing attack
rows.reason_zh: 小小仍会从原处取走一棵树作为武器，本次只增加了抓树距离。

rows.quote: Grabs a tree
rows.reason_zh: 抓树这次施放选取树木，说明中对远处单位发动攻击属于后续投树。

rows.quote: the movement speed bonus is reduced to %broken_movement_speed% for %break_time% seconds
rows.reason_zh: 装备仍提供移动速度加成，攻击英雄或受到攻击时该加成暂时降低。

rows.quote: broken_health_regen.base: null→2
rows.reason_zh: 装备仍提供生命恢复，攻击英雄或受到攻击后也会保留2点生命恢复。

rows.quote: The eyes last for %duration% seconds
rows.reason_zh: 说明给出的是丛林之眼的持续时间，材料没有可核实每次施放消耗一点充能的文字或字段。

rows.quote: grants him unobstructed vision in that location
rows.reason_zh: 被附魔的树仍为树精卫士提供当地视野。

rows.quote: Treant Protector enchants a tree, which grants him unobstructed vision in that location.
rows.reason_zh: 丛林之眼仍明确提供不受阻挡的视野，两版材料没有显示该效果的获取条件发生迁移。

rows.quote: The eyes last for %duration% seconds and are invisible
rows.reason_zh: 隐身的是树上的眼，说明没有赋予施法者、友军、召唤物或复制体隐身。

rows.quote: are destroyed if their host tree is destroyed
rows.reason_zh: 宿主树被摧毁会导致眼消失，技能本身没有摧毁树木的效果。

rows.quote: If the enemy has True Sight, they will be able to see which trees are enchanted.
rows.reason_zh: 真视是敌方看见附魔树的条件，丛林之眼自身提供的是无阻挡视野。

rows.quote: Treant Protector enchants a tree
rows.reason_zh: 施放目标是树木，没有选取敌方单位的施放方式。

rows.quote: Treant's attack plants a life-sapping seed in an enemy unit. That unit takes additional magic damage
rows.reason_zh: 基础攻击只对被种下种子的单位追加伤害，伤害范围内所有敌人属于命石说明中的地面施放效果。

rows.quote: Treant's attack plants a life-sapping seed in an enemy unit.
rows.reason_zh: 攻击仍会给命中的敌人种下种子并触发额外效果。

rows.quote: is rooted and disarmed for a short duration
rows.reason_zh: 目标仍同时受到缠绕和缴械，期间不能移动或普通攻击，符合捆缚定义。

rows.quote: AbilityManaCost.base: 35→20
rows.reason_zh: 字段变动只涉及魔耗，决定可破坏性的IsBreakable字段没有变化，原接受判断仍成立。

rows.quote: is rooted and disarmed for a short duration
rows.reason_zh: 被种下种子的敌方单位仍会短暂受到缴械。

rows.quote: emits %healing_pulse_count% healing pulses to up to %max_heal_units% nearby allies of Treant Protector
rows.reason_zh: 种子仍会发出治疗脉冲，为附近友军恢复生命。

rows.quote: That unit takes additional magic damage
rows.reason_zh: 种子附加一段魔法伤害，说明没有提高目标所受物理伤害或全部伤害的效果。

rows.quote: That unit takes additional magic damage
rows.reason_zh: 该次攻击附带额外魔法伤害，说明没有降低目标魔抗或放大所受法术伤害的效果。

rows.quote: Treant's attack plants a life-sapping seed in an enemy unit.
rows.reason_zh: 原文明确了攻击命中的敌人，但没有说明主动施放时能否选取敌方单位，魔耗变化也无法确定指向方式。

rows.quote: Vines slow down and deal damage to enemies that walk through.
rows.reason_zh: 藤蔓仍能伤害穿过它的多个敌人，本次移除了对小兵的伤害折减。

rows.quote: Creates vines towards the target location. Vines slow down and deal damage to enemies that walk through.
rows.reason_zh: 藤蔓仍留在通往目标地点的地面上，持续影响经过的敌人。

rows.quote: Vines slow down and deal damage to enemies that walk through.
rows.reason_zh: 穿过藤蔓的敌人仍会被减速。

rows.quote: Applies a Basic Dispel.
rows.reason_zh: 战斗专注仍会施加弱驱散。

rows.quote: Damage does not kill you during this mode.
rows.reason_zh: 战斗专注期间伤害仍无法致死，说明保留了淘汰之刃的例外。

rows.quote: Troll can still be killed with Axe's Culling Blade.
rows.reason_zh: 斩杀来自斧王的淘汰之刃，战斗专注自身没有按生命阈值击杀目标的效果。

rows.quote: Troll is granted vision over the target.
rows.reason_zh: 巨魔战将仍会获得目标的视野。

rows.quote: Grants you bonus lifesteal, attack speed, status resistance, and movement speed.
rows.reason_zh: 战斗专注仍提高巨魔战将自身的移动速度。

rows.quote: Grants you bonus lifesteal
rows.reason_zh: 战斗专注仍提供额外吸血。

rows.quote: slow_resistance.base: 35→null
rows.reason_zh: 原有35%减速抗性已删除，7.42改为攻击时无法被减速，并另行提供状态抗性。

rows.quote: forces you to continuously attack the closest enemy unit within %range% range, prioritizing heroes
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍强迫巨魔战将持续攻击范围内的敌人并优先选择英雄，符合强迫自身攻击的嘲讽定义。

new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 7.42新增基础状态抗性，三级战斗专注分别提供15%、20%和25%。

rows.quote: Tusk reaches out to tag an allied unit, pulling them closer.
rows.reason_zh: 双方距离达到拉动条件时，海民仍会把目标友军拉近。

rows.quote: movespeed_bonus.base: 25→30
rows.reason_zh: 海民和被标记友军仍获得移速加成，数值从25提高到30，材料没有显示升级条件变动。

rows.quote: Doesn't pull Tusk or targeted ally if they are within %min_distance% range of each other.
rows.reason_zh: 说明仍将海民自身列为可被拉动的一方，并明确双方距离过近时不发生位移。

rows.quote: Once tagged, both Tusk and his tagged ally gain movement speed and armor.
rows.reason_zh: 材料只说明拉动、加速和护甲效果，没有说明魔晶是否允许海民移动时穿越不可通行地形。

rows.quote: Cannot be refreshed and is not affected by cooldown reduction.
rows.reason_zh: 新增文字只涉及减冷却，变动字段中没有IsBreakable，原先拒绝可被破坏的判断不受此次变动影响。

rows.quote: When Undying dies he will instantly respawn in the fountain.
rows.reason_zh: 技能生效时，尸王死亡后仍会立即在泉水重生。

rows.quote: causes attacks to slow, apply damage amplification, and spawn Tombstone zombies
rows.reason_zh: 变身后的普通攻击仍会附带减速和伤害加深。

rows.quote: bonus movement speed
rows.reason_zh: 尸王在变身期间仍获得移动速度加成。
伤害加深的数值下调，各级仍分别有20%、25%和30%的加深效果。

rows.quote: causes attacks to slow
rows.reason_zh: 变身后的攻击仍会降低目标的移动速度。

rows.quote: Undying rips health away from all nearby units and uses it to heal an ally, or damage an enemy.
rows.reason_zh: 说明明确会从附近多个单位抽取生命，但只明确对一个敌方目标造成伤害，无法确认范围抽取本身是否按伤害结算。

rows.quote: Does rip from spell immune allies, including zombies.
rows.reason_zh: 说明描述的是噬魂与已有技能免疫的单位如何交互，技能本身没有赋予减益免疫。

rows.quote: tombstone_heal.base: [4,8,12,16]→[1,2,3,4]
rows.reason_zh: 噬魂仍可治疗友军，对墓碑的治疗量也仍在各级大于零。

rows.quote: uses it to heal an ally, or damage an enemy
rows.reason_zh: 噬魂仍可选取一个敌人作为伤害目标，也可选取友军进行治疗。

rows.quote: Zombies will frequently spawn next to every enemy unit in the area around the Tombstone, and attack them.
rows.reason_zh: 墓碑在范围内各个敌人旁生成僵尸，由僵尸分别攻击目标，基础说明没有直接造成范围伤害的效果。

rows.quote: which causes their attacks to slow the target
rows.reason_zh: 僵尸的普通攻击仍会附带减速。

rows.quote: Zombies and Tombstone are Spell Immune.
rows.reason_zh: 墓碑和僵尸仍具有技能免疫。

rows.quote: if the target reaches below a certain amount of health, increases the attack and movement speed of the zombie
rows.reason_zh: 目标生命低于阈值时，僵尸仍会提高自身移动速度。

rows.quote: Tombstone is Spell Immune, but can be healed by Soul Rip.
rows.reason_zh: 治疗由噬魂提供，墓碑是接受治疗的一方。

rows.quote: Zombies have the Deathlust ability, which causes their attacks to slow the target
rows.reason_zh: 僵尸的攻击仍会降低目标的移动速度。

rows.quote: ability_has_shard: true→false
rows.reason_zh: 7.42已关闭墓碑的魔晶升级，即使魔晶说明仍有眩晕文字，该条件下拒绝眩晕的判断仍成立。

rows.quote: zombie_health.base: 2→1
rows.reason_zh: 墓碑和僵尸的生命数值均有调整，但字段没有说明它们按伤害量还是按受击次数扣除，无法核实召唤物的拒绝判断。
